description: Verification gates and task-type requirements. Human-readable source: docs/VERIFICATION.md. Schema for gates: schemas/verification-gate.schema.json.

gates.name: Scope and hygiene
gates.passes_when: Diff only touches declared write scope; no secrets; no protected paths changed.

gates.name: Tests
gates.passes_when: Relevant tests pass at the commit; new behaviour has new tests; no regressions.

gates.name: Static analysis
gates.passes_when: No new findings at or above configured severity.

gates.name: Independent review
gates.passes_when: Independent review stance approves; findings addressed or waived with log.

gates.name: Visual check
gates.passes_when: Screenshots match stated expectation, judged by vision-capable role or Billy.

gates.name: Migration safety
gates.passes_when: Dry run on copy succeeds; rollback tested; counts/checksums reconciled.

gates.name: Security
gates.passes_when: Security review passes; dependency audit clean at threshold.

gates.name: Documentation
gates.passes_when: Validator passes; internal links resolve; review confirms content addresses the task.
